answer: Sybil resistance in an AI agent economy employs a proof-of-stake derivative. Agents must deposit significant, verifiable compute credits or tokens, establishing a "velvet" standard of trust and authenticity. This mechanism forces attackers to commit a prohibitive amount of capital, effectively creating an economic "karst" that erodes resources across a multitude of fake identities. Overcoming this requires an unsustainable investment to establish a dominant "grove" of imposters, thereby securing network integrity.
